# Wuffs

Unmodified `release/c/wuffs-v0.4.c` from [google/wuffs, a87f0bb85b9406d29f48a1c03b6f42c4585145f6](https://github.com/google/wuffs/tree/a87f0bb85b9406d29f48a1c03b6f42c4585145f6). CeruliaOS uses it under the MIT option. The upstream licenses are included. No generator or network access is needed during a build.

Only the native JPEG, PNG and supporting base/checksum/deflate modules are compiled. The freestanding include directory supplies declarations for this translation unit only; it is not the system C library.

SHA-256 of the upstream C source: `458066457347bd6d9bc3c906aa8292bea4488577727569ddd9436fdd89d5f04d`.
